fact_definitions.fact_role_rationale: Redundant historical representation; executable reinduction routing uses canonical induction_regimen=CPX351 per AML-3/AML-3A.
AML-9 describes long versus relatively short first remission without a numeric month threshold; raw interval is retained but not converted into an unsupported cutoff.
AML-7 explicitly uses prior FLT3-inhibitor exposure in the post-chemotherapy maintenance route.
Used only to determine whether a targeted agent may be retried; it does not suppress first exposure to a different targeted agent.

fact_definitions.description: Human/source-context determination that first remission is long enough for source-described reinduction consideration; no numeric cutoff is invented.
FLT3 internal tandem duplication (ITD) is explicitly distinguished from other FLT3 alterations for AML-7/AML-E option applicability.
